The '''Ghentiw Northern Mountains''' were a range of rocky, ragged peaks located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bundim]]. The [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] were located just outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Heg]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] soldiers regrouped in this mountain range after fighting in the [[Battle of Heg]], and it was the location of the [[Bundim Rebel Base]].
